strengths_deep_dive: Ta'leef Collective serves a niche population by delivering specialized programming for converts and youth. In 2023, the organization facilitated <cite id="5">101 shahadas and 30 nikkahs</cite>, while reaching roughly <cite id="5">1,300 weekly beneficiaries</cite> across events and media channels. Established in <cite id="5">2005</cite>, its track record shows sustained community presence in religious and cultural programming.
rich_narrative.summary: Ta'leef Collective provides religious education, community support, and specialized convert care, but faces severe financial efficiency issues. Founded in 2005, the organization offers programs such as <cite id="5">Convert Care, Inheritors, and Ta'leef Academy</cite> to assist individuals in their understanding of Islam. In FY2024, the charity reported a <cite id="3">total revenue of $1,397,233</cite>, reflecting growth from <cite id="3">$626,510 in 2020</cite>. While the organization fulfills a niche social role and is <cite id="1">zakat-eligible</cite>, significant operational limitations exist. Specifically, the organization allocates a <cite id="2">program expense ratio of 11.7%</cite> according to tax and rating data, which is well below the 75% sector benchmark. Additionally, third-party governance oversight is lacking, as demonstrated by a <cite id="2">0/20 standard rating from the BBB Wise Giving Alliance</cite> and an <cite id="2">overall score of 40.0/100 from Charity Navigator</cite>. Consequently, prospective donors face significant spending efficiency concerns despite the charity's active programming.
